learning_outcomes.text: Be able to operate with matrices and determinants, and solve systems of linear equations.
Be able to implement numerical methods for the approximate solution of linear algebra problems.
Be able to analyze the structure of a finite-dimensional vector subspace and linear applications defined between them.
Be able to classify conics and quadrics, and to distinguish their main elements.
Be able to calculate the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of a matrix, as well as to analyze its possible diagonalization.
Know how to classify and represent a quadratic form matrix, as well as be able to write them as a sum of squares.
Know the basic concepts of curve and surface theory, as well as the most common surfaces and their characteristic elements. Be able to solve geometric problems involving curved curves and surfaces.

syllabus_topics: Change of basis. Equations of change of basis.
Matrix associated with a linear application. Change of basis.
Topic 5. Bilinear forms and quadratic forms.
Coordinate expression of a bilinear form. Types of bilinear forms.
Coordinate expression of a quadratic form. Characterization. Associated polar form.
Polar of a point. Pole of a line. Theorem.
Reduced equation of a conic. Classification.
Reduced equation of a quadric. Classification.
Topic 9. Numerical methods of linear algebra.
Numerical solution of systems of linear equations. Gaussian elimination.
Laboratory Practice 1. Numerical solution of systems of linear equations.
Laboratory Practice 2. Matrix diagonalization: eigenvalues and eigenvectors.
teaching_methods: Theoretical teachings (lectures) for presenting fundamental concepts, procedures, and examples.
Practical teachings (problem-solving) focused on applying theoretical concepts to exercises and problems, including those from related subjects.
Non-contact personal work for solving problems and questions related to theory.

Practical teachings (laboratory) introducing symbolic calculation software (Mathematica) for solving exercises and problems requiring algorithms, focusing on the numerical part of the subject using computers.
assessment_rules: This course is in extinction. Consult activities and evaluation system in the virtual classroom.
